summary: Tested iteration-5 features: sprint burndown API+dialog, task comments with @mentions (API+UI), weekly-digest cron endpoint, Idle>2h KPI, plus regression. Backend: 47/47 pytest tests pass (19 new). Burndown returns full contract, series length == (end-start+1) days (15 for Sprint 1: 08-27 -> 09-10), ideal decreases linearly from 17.5 to 0 with constant step, actual numeric for past/today and null for future dates, 404 wrong sprint_id, 403 non-member org, 401 unauthenticated, and 200 for a role=member org member. Comments: POST returns author_name/author_email, mentions resolved to user_ids (only existing users) while mentions_emails keeps all parsed emails, 404 missing task, 422 missing body, GET list sorted asc by created_at with author enrichment and no _id leakage. Cron: no auth -> 401, wrong secret -> 401, valid Bearer(WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET)+X-Webhook-Id -> 200 {ok,queued}, same X-Webhook-Id -> 200 {ok,duplicate}, db.cron_runs record verified via motor, and backend logs show _build_and_send_digest ran with no exception (email proxy returned 202). Frontend: burndown-btn-{sprint_id} present on sprint card, dialog shows 3 stat tiles (1/5, 17.5h, 15d) and a Recharts LineChart with 2 lines (Ideal dashed strokeDasharray 5 5 + solid indigo Actual) and legend. TaskDialog shows Comments under Save changes with avatars, name, time-ago, indigo mention pills; typing '@' shows mention-{user_id} suggestions and clicking inserts '@<email>'; comment-submit-btn creates the comment and it appears immediately with input cleared. TeamActivity shows 4 KPI cards incl. idle-alerts-kpi (0 Idle > 2h) and the JSX elapsed>7200 red/'Idle > 2h' code path was verified by inspection (lines 77,107-114,170-181). Regression OK: login, all 5 task views, board columns render, timer start (start-timer-*) / stop (timer-stop-btn), projects/sprints/members/analytics/dashboard nav, logout -> /login.

minor.issue: CommentCreate.body has no min_length/max_length: body="" and body="   " are accepted (200) and a 20,000-char body is stored. UI blocks empty, but the API allows junk comments. Add constr(min_length=1, max_length=~5000) + .strip() validation.

Inconsistent response contract when the sprint has no start/end date: returns only {sprint_id, total_estimate_hours, series: []} (no sprint_name/start_date/end_date/total_tasks/completed_tasks). Any consumer reading those fields would break.

end_date < start_date is accepted at sprint creation and silently yields series: [] (frontend then shows the misleading 'Set start & end dates on this sprint' empty state). Validate date order (400) or return an explicit reason.

asyncio.create_task(_build_and_send_digest()) result is not stored anywhere; the task can be garbage-collected mid-flight and exceptions are swallowed. Keep a module-level set of task refs (or use FastAPI BackgroundTasks) and add a done-callback that logs exceptions.
No DELETE /api/orgs/{org_id}/sprints/{sprint_id} endpoint exists (returns 404), so sprints created via API/UI cannot be removed — leftover test sprints had to be deleted directly in Mongo.
File is now 1032 lines (>700 guideline); also EMAIL_BASE_URL is hardcoded and `import re as _re` / `import asyncio as _asyncio` are done mid-file instead of at the top.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking a mention suggestion the textarea is never re-focused (pickMention only calls setBody), so the caret/focus is lost and continued typing can land at position 0 — reproduced text 'QA automated commenthello @test_qa_member_...@example.com'. Focus the textarea and set selectionStart/End to the end of the inserted text.
No error state: load() and submit() have no try/catch on the GET/POST — a failed request silently does nothing (no toast/inline error). Comment list also has no loading skeleton.

api.get(...).then() has no .catch() — a 404/500 leaves the dialog stuck on 'Loading…' forever. Add an error state. Also data.total_estimate_hours.toFixed(1) will throw if the field is ever absent (it IS absent in the no-dates response branch, though that path is short-circuited by series.length===0 today).

issues: Layout/contrast/legend read well. DialogContent has no Description/aria-describedby (React a11y warning logged twice in console). Stat tile label says 'Total tasks' but shows 'completed / total' (1 / 5) — consider labelling it 'Tasks done'.

Dialog is now tall enough that the Title field scrolls out of view on a 1080p viewport when the comments list is populated; consider a max-height + sticky Save area or a scoped scroll for the comments list only (max-h-56 exists but the whole dialog still grows).
4 KPI cards render fine; idle KPI turns red only when idleAlerts>0 (verified in code). Duplicate 'TEST_RegularMember' rows exist from earlier iterations' seed data — clean up.

action_items: Add body length/strip validation to CommentCreate (empty and 20k-char comments are currently accepted).
Return the full burndown field set (or 400) when the sprint has no start/end date, and validate end_date >= start_date.
Hold a reference to the weekly-digest background task and log its exceptions instead of fire-and-forget create_task.
Re-focus the comment textarea with the caret at the end after picking an @mention.
Add .catch()/error UI to BurndownDialog and TaskComments API calls.
Add aria-describedby/DialogDescription to BurndownDialog to clear the React a11y warning.
Consider adding DELETE for sprints and splitting server.py (1032 lines) into routers.
critical_code_review_comments: Burndown 'actual' is derived only from tasks' completed_at + estimate_hours; tasks reopened after completion (completed_at kept) will keep counting as burned down. Clear completed_at when status leaves 'done'.
list_comments/create_comment correctly project out _id and password_hash; no ObjectId leakage observed.
MENTION_RE requires a full email after '@'; plain @username mentions are silently ignored — intentional per spec but worth documenting in the placeholder text (it already says 'Use @email').
cron endpoint compares the secret with a plain != (no hmac.compare_digest) — timing-safe compare would be better for a shared secret.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (3 minor robustness/UX gaps)

Testids: input-email/input-password/submit-auth-btn, nav-{route}, view-{list|board|gantt|calendar|workload}, edit-task-{id}, start-timer-{task_id} (list view) and timer-stop-btn (topbar), burndown-btn-{sprint_id}, comment-input/comment-submit-btn/comment-{comment_id}/mention-{user_id}, idle-alerts-kpi. There is NO org-switcher-btn / kanban-card-* testid — use visible text for those. Org id: org_2bbdf30d5e46; Sprint 1 = 08-27 -> 09-10, 5 tasks, 17.5h estimate.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects in the new features. The @mention caret jump comes from pickMention() calling setBody() without restoring focus/selection to the textarea, so the browser leaves focus on the suggestion button and the next keystroke lands wherever the caret is re-placed (position 0 in an automated focus). The comment-body validation gap is simply CommentCreate.body being a bare str with no constraints.
